protocol.budget_original: Original envelope PCA48; RBF is additionally retained as the untuned audited-family baseline.

budget_protocol.policy: Same nested geometry subsets and historical evaluation cases for all families; fit representation on each subset; report tuning and runtime, and do not select models from historical-test curves.

protocol.candidate_source: Fixed RBF/Matern32 alternatives, neural learning rates .001/.0003
protocol.evaluation: Previously inspected historical test; no use in tuning or final-model selection.
protocol.isolation: Every fit, representation and hyperparameter comparison uses only this HF-budget subset. No winner imported from the 48-run model selection.
protocol.modal_stratification: Validation partitions may use accepted-label availability only within the already counted training budget; sparse/unserved modes remain failures.
protocol.repeat_limit: At budget48 all repeats share the same HF geometries; seeds/validation splits vary, not independent HF datasets.
protocol.subsets: Three fixed random nested permutations; do not redraw an unsuccessful modal-coverage budget.
